# SUN POLAR

> Taiwan-based OEM/ODM manufacturer specializing in medical-grade compression stockings, athletic compression socks, and therapeutic wear with advanced fiber technologies.

SUN POLAR is a leading compression wear manufacturer offering customizable solutions for medical, athletic, and occupational applications. The company leverages proprietary materials including Lycra, Spandex, Far Infrared Germanium yarn, and recycled fibers to deliver graduated compression products across multiple categories.

## Key Topics

- Medical Compression Stockings
- Compression Socks
- OEM/ODM Manufacturing
- Graduated Compression
- Lycra & Spandex Fibers
- Far Infrared Germanium Yarn
- Anti-Embolism Stockings
- Deep Vein Thrombosis Prevention
- Circulation Support
- Custom Manufacturing
- Athletic Compression Wear
- Medical-Grade Compression
- Recycled Polyester & Nylon
- Compression Sleeves & Braces
- Occupational Compression Wear
